description: Local Area Guides for Metro stations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides Local Area Guides for 13 Metro Stations along the Sydney's Metro North West Line. Each guide displays a local area map with an approximate 600m radius around the Metro station capturing bus stands, facilities, tickets and destinations. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Local area map, M1, Metro City to Sydenham, Metro North West and Bankstown Line, Metro Northwest. It offers 25 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-08-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
